source: The live demo script from issue #69, run verbatim from the repository root on 2026-10-29 with Node v26.0.0 (tools/render.mjs, recipe nutrition@4.0.0 verified against tools/catalog.sql, Satori 0.36.0 + resvg). The exported run folders live in the untracked .relay-scratch/talk-demo/; the two PNGs below are byte copies of their render.png, and receipts/ holds their result.json and manifest.json.
timing: Wall time per render command including Node startup, measured with /usr/bin/time -p on the operator's Mac: 0.39 to 0.61 s. Issue #69 recorded 0.38 to 0.75 s on 2026-10-29. Say 'under a second', not 'milliseconds'.
imagery: No image model was called for this deck. The two embedded renders contain the nutrition example's seven AI-generated cutouts (gpt-image-2.5-flare, see tools/spike/assets/SOURCES.md); the deck's own slides, diagrams and type are engine output.
receipts: receipts/<run>.result.json and receipts/<run>.manifest.json are the published run receipts. In the three result.json files the operator's home-directory prefix in normalized.inputPath was replaced by '~' before committing (public repo), so their bytes no longer match the result.json digest recorded in the matching manifest.json; the render.png and render.svg digests are untouched and are the ones the deck pins.
